values.note: 2026: water and electric (30 or 50 amp) $47 a night, $57 on holidays (Memorial Day, 4th of July, Labor Day); water, electric and sewer $52, holiday $62; sites 108 and 109 $5 more. Rates cover two people; extra people $3 a night (age 3 and under free), six at most. Plus sales tax. 7th night free on weekly stays; monthly $700 (30 amp) / $750 (50 amp); seasonal April 15-September 30 $2,300-$2,400. A tent added to an RV site is $15 a night. Cancel 7 days ahead or pay the whole stay.

note: Private campground on Forestville Creek next to Forestville/Mystery Cave State Park in the southeast Minnesota bluff country; horse trailers welcome, dog park, playground, hiking and snowmobiling. Most numbered sites (1-25, 36-50 and A-E on the 2022 map) are seasonal; overnight RVs use the 101-118 spur loop and sites 26 and 32-35. Rottweilers, pit bulls, Dobermans, Staffordshire terriers and their mixes are not allowed. --Claude
summary: Operator site and its 2026 rate/FAQ/map images read: W/E (30/50 amp) $47 a night for two plus tax (holiday $57), W/E/S $52, sites 108/109 +$5, extra person $3, max 6, 3-night holiday minimum, 7-day cancellation; showers, laundry, Wi-Fi, store, dump. Monthly and seasonal rates marketed; the 2022 map marks 45 of ~68 RV sites seasonal. Google 4.6 (106). Passes price and presence; long-stay tests reported below. Count, max length and pull-through left as stored (not stated).
flags: PRIVATE GATES: base $47/night (water+electric, 2 people, 2026, before sales tax) - under US$50, no gateway needed; holiday $57 (three holiday weekends only). Presence: operator website maplespringscampground.com live with phones 507-352-2056 (office) and 507-951-8876 (cell). Google Maps 4.6 stars from 106 reviews (phone listed there is the cell). RV Life stored 5 stars / $$.

LONG-STAY (reviewer's call, I read it as a seasonal-heavy park that still sells nights, NOT a drop): operator markets 'Seasonal Camping Rates: April 15th - September 30th - $2300 - 2400' and monthly $700/$750; the 2022 campground map says 'Seasonal Sites: #1-25, 36-50, A, B, C, D, E' = 45 of about 68 RV sites. The overnight loop 101-118 (18 sites) plus 26 and 32-35 remain, about 1 in 3 - passes test 4 (1 in 10). Test 2 passes (nightly rate posted on its own site). No booking engine, so no occupancy check was possible. Google 4.6 is well above 4.0, so the 'under 4 + borderline seasonal' auto-drop does not apply. Imagery shows the creek row and the west loop densely occupied by long-stay units, the 101-118 loop mostly empty.

Not waterfront kept: Forestville Creek runs in the woods north of the creek-side row (sites 7-25, all seasonal); on imagery the pads back onto continuous woods with the creek out of sight, and the nightly 101-118 loop is in the open field 60+ m from the creek.
Pin 43.63700,-92.23720 sits in the woods ~90 m NE of the pad row (centre of the sites about 43.6365,-92.2365): OK, under 250 m.
Phone 507-352-2056 matches (office); Google lists the cell 507-951-8876. Website unchanged.
Season: only the seasonal-rate window (April 15-September 30) is posted; no campground open/close statement, so season not written.
Breed restriction (in note): 'we do not allow Rottweiler, Pit Bulls, Dobermans, Staffordshire Terrier or any mix there of'.
Note cleaned: dropped site counts, hookups/amps, max RV ~55 ft, pull-through, dump, store and showers (fields hold them); added the seasonal-site layout and breed rule.
